description: Six sine wave low frequency oscillators from one clock: one at the clock's own rate and the others at a half, a third, a quarter, a fifth and a sixth of it

params.text: Sets the rate of the internal clock, 0.1Hz to 10Hz, and is not read while a cable is patched to the clock input

inputs.text: Takes the rate from the time between rising edges here, reading high above 1V and low below 0V

outputs.text: A sine wave at ±5V at the clock rate
A sine wave at ±5V at half the clock rate
A sine wave at ±5V at a third of the clock rate
A sine wave at ±5V at a quarter of the clock rate
A sine wave at ±5V at a fifth of the clock rate
A sine wave at ±5V at a sixth of the clock rate

notes: with a cable in the clock input every output stays at 0V until two rising edges have arrived, because the rate is measured between them; unpatched, the knob drives it from the start

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the knob sets the rate; a negative voltage does nothing here.
